{"search_note":"I did **not** find 2024 evidence of any of the following:
- a new independent nuclear safety office or technical advisory body,
- expanded transparency or verification institutions,
- civilian expert oversight of launch/custody decisions,
- or a public move to reduce the role of loyalists / ideologues in favor of specialized risk experts.

So for `1B.7`, the evidence is **mostly absence-of-proof against** rather than positive proof for institutional investment.","evidence":[{"title":"Book of Xi's discourses on Party discipline published","publisher":"Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn","date":"2024-05-26","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html","summary":"Xi’s discipline campaign was framed as strengthening discipline awareness and making cadres “loyal, clean and responsible.” This suggests an attempt to improve institutional discipline, but it is Party discipline, not independent risk expertise.","question_ids":["1B.7"]},{"title":"Xi inspects Rocket Force brigade","publisher":"Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn","date":"2024-10-19","url":"https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202410/19/content_WS67136968c6d0868f4e8ec184.html","summary":"Xi emphasized Party absolute leadership, good command, training, and combat preparedness. This shows attention to organizational competence, but the stress is on loyalty and deterrence rather than autonomous safety expertise.","question_ids":["1B.7","1B.3"]},{"title":"China's nuclear policy remains stable, consistent and predictable: spokesperson","publisher":"PRC Ministry of National Defense","date":"2024-09-26","url":"https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/NewsRelease/16341310.html","summary":"After the ICBM launch, the spokesperson described nuclear policy as stable, consistent, predictable, and based on no-first-use and minimum required capability. This is relevant because it shows Xi investing in centralized control structures, but not in depoliticized nuclear expertise.","question_ids":["1B.7"]},{"title":"Li Shangfu expelled from the Party","publisher":"Xinhua","date":"2024-06-27","url":"https://www.xinhuanet.com/20240627/f929f9248c9f40bc8f9afe791c6a716f/c.html","summary":"The purge of a former defense minister reflects serious corruption inside the military elite.
